_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 04 of the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain wires the navigation + page skeleton that members 05-07 will fill in. Two navigation entries (BBV Compliance Dashboard + Budget Mapping with index/detail) are added under a top-level 'BBV' menu, ordered immediately after the main Dashboard (order 11) and gated to waterschap administrations. The dashboard page is declared as type=dashboard with an empty widget list (widgets are added in slice 05). The Budget Mapping index+detail pages are declared against the BudgetBBVMapping schema (introduced in slice 01) — the bespoke pickers + relations live in slices 06/07 which will re-declare them as kind=page custom components when needed. The HTTP-level routes that mirror these manifest pages are registered in appinfo/routes.php with explicit #[NoAdminRequired] auth attributes per ADR-016 + hydra-gate-route-auth.
_meta.slice-06-update: Slice 06 (bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant-06-mapping-index) swaps the BudgetBBVMappings page from type=index → type=custom + component=BudgetBBVMappingIndex so the manifest router dispatches the bespoke CnIndexPage wrapper that owns the four-facet filter chrome (search, fiscal year, allocation bucket, effective-date window) and the percentage/status cell renderers REQ-BBVW-004 calls for. The legacy `columns` array + `defaultSort` are dropped because the custom component declares them in code; the `register`, `schema`, `detailRoute` config keys are retained so the component still reads them from the manifest page config.

config._note: CONFIG — a waterschappen BBV budget mapping that pins a GL ledger account to a programme/task-field with a budgeted amount, driving BBV-conformant aggregation. Body is a compact key-value mapping; the audit trail (who changed the allocation and when) is the single sidebar tab. A mapping row has no documents, children or correspondence — data + audit only.
